chronology.already_inspected: Publication methods/results, producer code, selected headers, full-source structural/numeric-token/namespace coverage; no A1C band paths or empirical fit inspected before this selection.
chronology.freeze_requirement: Commit and push this protocol and its registry/RFC before band mapping, allocation diagnostics, fitting or reserved-outcome evaluation. No preregistration or independent-source validation claim.

source.association: Exact sample-key match, full possible partner graph including ambiguous keys before all quarantine/assay/day filters, mutually degree-one subjects and unique right row as frozen v2. Consistency is not independently certified identity.

measurement.threshold_source: Zhou et al. 2019, Results Overview: cohort, sample collection and assays; DOI10.1038/s41586-019-1236-x. NIDDK A1C test supports percent cutoffs and separate diagnosis confirmation.
measurement.threshold_precision: Classify original finite Decimal without rounding; low<5.7, middle>=5.7 and<6.5, high>=6.5. Labels do not establish metabolic health, insulin resistance, diagnosis, disease type or remission.
measurement.unavailable_or_invalid_assay: Retain each token category and all original denominators; omit unavailable/outside-definitional-percent-range rows only from the conditional observed-path likelihood. No imputation or unit inference from values.
measurement.unused: GLU, clinical CollectionDate, CL4 and all other fields supply no predictor, context filter, outcome or treatment history.

time_and_paths.specimen_clock: SampleInfo.Days_Since_Start interpreted as specimen elapsed-day coordinate, an explicit unverified working assumption; no calendar or annual-rate conversion.
time_and_paths.origin: Subtract first eligible Decimal coordinate within each label before conversion to float. Preserve fractional gaps. Unknown additive origin cancels.
time_and_paths.rows: Partition admitted rows in order: unusable day, unavailable assay, outside percent range, eligible assay/day; preserve all source/linkage and subject denominators.
time_and_paths.duplicate_time: Any repeated eligible Decimal time quarantines the entire label from fitting/evaluation, including identical bands; preserve duplicate counts. Do not average, deduplicate or arbitrarily order ties.
time_and_paths.single_observation: Retain denominator; conditional first-band likelihood contributes no rate information or predictive target.
time_and_paths.ordering: Sort finite eligible Decimal times within exact metadata subject label; no subject normalization or clinical namespace override.
time_and_paths.floating_representation: Require finite strictly increasing centered float coordinates and every converted gap positive; otherwise quarantine whole label as coordinate_conversion_loss. Never collapse distinct Decimal times.

conditioning.estimand: Effective homogeneous usual-care switching between recorded A1C bands in this selected available panel, conditional on first recorded band, recorded specimen times and assay availability; no biological, clinical, causal or national hazard claim.
conditioning.likelihood: Sum across labels and consecutive observations log([exp(Q*elapsed_source_days)]previous_band,next_band); exact recorded-band process, not latent disease-state fit.
assumptions: Conditional timing and assay availability treated as ignorable for this working likelihood, not established by source.
Homogeneous Markov recorded-band dynamics despite A1C temporal averaging, visit triggers and individual heterogeneity.
Observed band taken as the process label; no freely fitted biological-state/measurement-error mixture.
Unmeasured changing treatment included in usual care; never held fixed or absent.
Selected complete available observation sequence only; no inferred death, withdrawal, missed-visit schedule, survival, independent censoring or administrative stop.
conditioning.terminal: No terminal contribution after last recorded measurement.

allocation.hash: sha256(salt UTF8 + NUL + exact metadata subject UTF8); full digest interpreted big endian modulo5
allocation.empty_partition: Report unresolved; never reassign labels or change salt after inspection.
allocation.privacy: Never export labels, digests, fold assignment, row values, coordinates, per-label paths or per-label scores.

models.primary: adjacent reversible CTMC, edges0->1,1->0,1->2,2->1; four free nonnegative rates per source day; diagonal minus row outflow
models.alternative: unrestricted general CTMC with all six ordered off-diagonal rates; same time/conditioning/evaluation rules
models.null_iid: Training follow-up pooled categorical probabilities; first band conditioned, no elapsed-time dependence; no pseudocounts
models.null_persistence: Exact no switching; retain impossible changed-band likelihood/predictions without a positive floor
models.selection: Report all models, no post-evaluation winner activation.

numerics.cap_meaning: Computational search limit, not empirical/biological bound. Any cap hit, open profile or fit failure retained; no complete identification or finite upper interval claimed there.
numerics.profile_support: Finite-grid likelihood-support and bracketing diagnostics only; not exact confidence endpoints. Chi-square df1 interpretation additionally assumes correctly specified independent-label working likelihood and regular interior asymptotics. Boundary, cap, open side or failed nuisance optimization precludes finite confidence-limit interpretation.
numerics.infinite_score: Serialize impossible log likelihood as null with explicit impossible flag/count, never floor or replace with zero. Reject substantive probability/conservation violations. Numerical correction only within declared roundoff tolerance.
numerics.design_jacobian_boundary_rule: Central differences only when both scaled perturbations remain in [0,scaled_cap]; otherwise explicit forward difference near zero or backward difference near cap, with actual denominator recorded. No negative rate evaluation; numerical local rank only.

evaluation.uncertainty: Paired whole-label resampling; training paths resampled with replacement for primary CTMC and IID fits; separately paired evaluation paths resampled for score differences. No individual prediction export.
evaluation.acceptance: No sourced clinical predictive tolerance; diagnostics are descriptive, no scientific acceptance switch. No independent source or causal validation.

joint_uncertainty.reported: Joint covariance and percentile summaries for primary four-rate vector, plus paired primary-versus-IID predictive score differences. Include requested/completed/failed/boundary/cap counts and Monte Carlo resolution.
joint_uncertainty.failures: No retry/redraw to replace unsupported resamples; summarize successful subset explicitly. Nonconvergence, cap hits and singular designs remain separate, not silently excluded from uncertainty interpretation.
joint_uncertainty.limits: Conditional cluster-resampling sampling uncertainty only, not assay units, linkage identity, treatment, visit selection, model structure, transport or causal uncertainty. Four marginals are not four independent priors.

identification: For both fitted CTMC structures: actual-training design conditional-probability Jacobian SVD/rank in declared scaled coordinates, boundary/cap diagnostics, profiled each rate with nuisance rates reoptimized. Full numerical rank alone never establishes clinical or global identification.
report: Attributed aggregate facts, conditional working-fit parameters and diagnostics only. Preserve frozen v1/v2 reports and raw bytes. Register the selection and result in evidence/parameters.yaml separately from active engine parameters; canonical simulations and scientific blockers remain unchanged.
